{{Quote|These ion engines have always lent themselves beautifully to sabotage! Nudge one energizer out of alignment&hellip; and the recharge system becomes a time bomb!|Anduvil, on ion engines|<ref name="TS" />}}
'''Energizers''' were [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components necessary for the recharging systems of [[P-s4 twin ion engine]]s present in spacecraft like the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Energizers were sensitive devices that needed to be properly aligned to work as intended. Misalignment of energizers in [[Twin ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] was dangerous, as they could explode like a [[time bomb]].<ref name="TS" />

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Tatooine Sojourn]]" are set between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and "[[Princess Leia, Imperial Servant]]." ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' places the events of "Princess Leia, Imperial Servant" shortly after the Battle of Yavin, in the timeframe ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' identifies as around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|intelligence operative]] [[Anduvil]] destroyed the [[Imperial garrison base]]<ref name="TS" /> on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], by infiltrating the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay and misaligning the energizer of a TIE fighter's [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]], causing an enormous blast that engulfed the military installation.<ref name="TS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Energizers were mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] strip "[[Tatooine Sojourn]]." The strip was written by [[Steve Gerber]], illustrated by [[Russ Manning]],<ref name="TS" /> and released from [[September 10]]th to [[November 5]]th in [[1979]] by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]].<ref name="Classic Newspaper">''[[Star Wars: The Classic Newspaper Comics Vol. 1]]''</ref> In the first recolorization of the comic strip, published in the [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures]]''<ref name="TEA4">[[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 4|''Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures'' 4'']]</ref> in 1994 by [[Dark Horse Comics]],<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/93-479/Classic-Star-Wars-The-Early-Adventures-4|text=Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures #4}}</ref> the panel that mentions the energizer is omitted.<ref name="TEA4" />
